title: Experimental Evidence on Structural State Dependence in Demand
authors: Sebastian Gabel; Daniel Guhl; Günter J. Hitsch; Kyoung Hwan (Joe) Kook
eligible_reason: Coupon field experiments used as instruments for past purchase: brand-level LATEs of structural state dependence (IV/Wald estimates), aggregated by Bayesian random-effects meta-analysis, and compared with choice-model LATEs. No DiD. Proprietary transaction data and estimation code not shipped; package releases brand-level estimates only.
design_notes: Package files are inside a nested zip (mksc.2024.1274) not extracted by the regression scan, hence the empty inventory. code/01_main_results/01_table_2.R and 07_stan/*.stan aggregate released LATE estimates (data/01_empirical_inputs/01_lates_experiment.csv).
data_files_note: Only brand-level estimates and a resampled illustrative Aero data set are shipped; raw transaction/coupon data withheld.
data_provenance_note: README: original firm data and processing code cannot be shared; Aero case-study data are resampled for illustration. Moot (no DiD).
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available at screening time (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked); screened from the package README, code, shipped data and the OpenAlex abstract. Title of package README/code matches the paper (no mismatch).
